wylie: lan du, las byas pa'i skad cig gnyis par 'gags zin pa'i snga logs kyi las 'gag pa la mngon du phyogs pa'i tshe, las kyi nus pa gzhag par bya ba'i phyir kha cig kun gzhi rnam par shes pa rtog par byed la, kha cig bu lon gyi dbang rgya ste de'i yi ge dang 'dra ba'i las gnyis las don gzhan pa, chud mi za ba zhes pa ldan min 'du byed du gyur pa cig 'dod do
english: In response to this, some people point to the karma which is approaching stopping: that karma just previous to the point at which the karma has stopped, in the second instant of the commission of the karma. In this moment, they say, there must be a place where the potential of the karma is deposited; and so it is that some people imagine that there must be a type of awareness known as “foundation consciousness.” And there are also some who say that there is some other entity, distinct from the two karmas, similar to a letter of credit or receipt for a loan; something—a separate changing entity that is neither physical nor mental—which consists of the fact that the karma will never just fade away.
